shape: Two-hub L-corridor (N+E gates with east-hub fan-out + west-arm dead-end)
description: Two-portal arena with two entry hubs (west and east) joined by a center bridge. The east hub (87wbe5) is the high-degree node — fans out to 4 anchors (NE corner, north area, south corner, center bridge). The west hub (wnughj) connects through a small clique (64g011 + 972a84) plus a SW dead-end pocket (vah1ye).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-16.91, -15.50) — gate on the NW corner
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.32, 2.93) — gate on the east side, mid-Z

traversalNotes: Direct N→E: spawn_north → north_inner → center_w → center_e → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops.
Alternative via west_mid: north_inner → west_mid → center_w → center_e → east_inner.

DISPATCH RULE: east_inner is the canonical dispatch anchor for east-side corner objectives (ne_corner, n_pocket, se_corner). west_mid + center_w handle west-side. sw_pocket is a single-degree detour off west_mid.
EAST HUB FAN-OUT: east_inner has 4 detour branches — pick the one matching the objective location.
